title: Handoff links
description: External references for one feature — the spec, the research, the design file, the ticket. Rendered by the Links page, read-only in the site and authored here.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within this file. Prefix 'l-', kebab-case.

kind.description: What sort of reference this is. Drives the icon and the label.

label.description: What the reader is opening, in their words rather than the URL's.

note.description: One line on why this is worth opening.

owner.description: Who to ask about it. Shown as an avatar.
